properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh). FIELD LOG 2026-10-06 (0.80.0, hxm_program hub): the Stop hook ran export_graph to docs/design/hxm_program.json and failed (exit 1, No such file or directory); every `reflow2 write` printed "no export was kept current — no --export-to was given, and no MCP configuration … names one"; `reflow2 init . --harness vscode-cli` had written docs/design/<project>.json plus .gitattributes and .gitignore lines for it, though the design exported to reflow2.json, and its --check preview did not name the .gitattributes edit.

② Searched the raw error text in reflow2 and flo2: no prior finding. ③ Candidates: (A) three readers, three sources; (B) init's convention ignores an existing export; (C) outside reflow2 — the project's path lives only in its own AGENTS.md/CI, and deleting docs/ by hand made the hook's path vanish; (D) a stale receipt from an older init; (E) the observation is wrong.

⑤ MEASURED in a scratch repo shaped like the hub (store + reflow2.json, no docs/, no prior receipt), with the 0.80.0 binary and main's kit: a write before and after init printed the same "no export was kept current" line; init recorded design_record = docs/design/proj.json in .reflow2/kit-version.json and created docs/design/proj.json, .gitattributes and a merge driver; loop_nudge.design_record() returned docs/design/proj.json and export_is_configured() False; the messages matched the log word for word. So A and B hold, D is refuted (a fresh repo, no old receipt), E is refuted, and C is only the trigger: with docs/ left in place the hook would have kept a SECOND export current while reflow2.json went stale. --check named none of the record, .gitattributes or the merge driver.

⑥ CLASS: where a project's export lives had no owner. call_export.rs read --export-to or an MCP configuration; loop_nudge read init's receipt (git-ignored, so a teammate's clone has none); reflow2_init's design_record_path was a fixed convention. None consulted the others or the export the project kept. Same class as fact:root-cause-call-accepts-export-to-and-never-reads-it-2026-10-02 and the flo2 field report of 2026-09-18 (the gate defaulted to design.json, which none of three projects had). A second, smaller class: init's --check preview was its own list beside the steps, with nothing comparing them.

⑦ PINNED, each observed failing on unfixed code: the Rust test a_recorded_export_in_reflow2_toml_is_the_file_a_writing_call_keeps (failed: `.reflow2.toml is not a pointer reflow2 can use: unknown field export`), test_init's test_the_terminal_route_adopts_the_export_the_project_already_has and test_the_preview_names_every_file_the_run_touches, and test_loop_nudge's test_a_recorded_export_is_left_to_the_writes_that_keep_it.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: the hub's own receipt was not read (inferred from the same code path); a member whose export lives in the hub's repo (outside its own repo) was not reproduced; `reflow2 update` on an already-initialised project was not exercised.
